// The diagnostic of the inserts (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index,
// "Pasada de diagnóstico del insert"): where the time of an insert goes, by
// the size of the index and by how many callers add at once. It measures and
// changes nothing of what an insert does.
//
// TestDiagInserts adds PE_N vectors to a clone of an index TestNightGrow
// left, as TestNightContinue does, with the vectors in memory before the
// clock starts, and writes to PE_OUT, at the start and after every PE_EVERY
// inserts, what has added up so far: the clocks of the callers, the counters
// and the clocks of the index, what the system accounts to the process, the
// metrics of the runtime, what the reads of the store consulted, the
// segments of every bucket and the bytes the files of the index grew by.
// TestDiagSearch runs the plans of the same vectors and applies none.
//
// Parameters, from the environment, besides PE_DATASET, PE_DIR, PE_OUT and
// PE_CACHE:
//   - PE_N: how many vectors (20 000).
//   - PE_CALLERS: how many callers add at once (8); PE_THREADS for
//     TestDiagSearch.
//   - PE_ROWS: the rows of the dataset the index was grown from, as given
//     to TestNightGrow (all of them).
//   - PE_KIND: which vectors. "repeated" (the default) are rows the index
//     holds, at random by PE_SEED, under new doc ids from PE_ROWS on; "fresh"
//     are the rows of the dataset from PE_ROWS on, which the index does not
//     hold, under their own; "queries" are the queries of the dataset, under
//     new doc ids.
//   - PE_EVERY: the inserts of a stretch (2 000).
//   - PE_CLOCKS: 0 leaves the clocks of the callers and the counters of the
//     store out (1).
//
// What only the diagnostic branch has, those clocks and counters and the
// counts of the work of a plan, is behind diagHooks, in a file of its own
// with a twin that does nothing: with the twin this harness builds over m2
// as it is, for the control of what the clocks cost.
//   - PE_WORK: 1 has every plan collect the counts of its work (0).
//   - PE_COMPACTION: 0 leaves the compaction cycle of the store unstarted
//     (1).
//   - PE_CPUPROFILE: a CPU profile of the inserts, from the first to the
//     last.
//   - PE_TRACE: an execution trace of PE_TRACE_SECONDS (8) from the middle
//     of the inserts.

// diagRusage is what the system accounts to this process so far:
// proc_pid_rusage with RUSAGE_INFO_V4, and getrusage for its faults and its
// context switches.
type diagRusage struct {
	UserNs        uint64 `json:"userNs"`
	SystemNs      uint64 `json:"systemNs"`
	RunnableNs    uint64 `json:"runnableNs"`
	Pageins       uint64 `json:"pageins"`
	Footprint     uint64 `json:"physFootprint"`
	BytesRead     uint64 `json:"diskBytesRead"`
	BytesWritten  uint64 `json:"diskBytesWritten"`
	LogicalWrites uint64 `json:"logicalWrites"`
	Instructions  uint64 `json:"instructions"`
	Cycles        uint64 `json:"cycles"`
	MajorFaults   int64  `json:"majorFaults"`
	MinorFaults   int64  `json:"minorFaults"`
	Voluntary     int64  `json:"voluntarySwitches"`
	Involuntary   int64  `json:"involuntarySwitches"`
}

func readDiagRusage() (diagRusage, error) {
	const procInfoCallPidRusage, rusageInfoV4 = 9, 4
	var buf [512]byte
	_, _, errno := syscall.Syscall6(syscall.SYS_PROC_INFO, procInfoCallPidRusage, uintptr(os.Getpid()), rusageInfoV4, 0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buf[0])), 0)
	if errno != 0 {
		return diagRusage{}, errors.Wrap(errno, "read the resource usage of the process")
	}
	// The uint64 of index i of rusage_info_v4, after its uuid of 16 bytes.
	word := func(i int) uint64 { return binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(buf[16+8*i:]) }
	// Its times are in units of mach_absolute_time: 125/3 ns on Apple silicon.
	ns := func(i int) uint64 {
		if runtime.GOARCH == "arm64" {
			return word(i) * 125 / 3
		}
		return word(i)
	}
	var self syscall.Rusage
	if err := syscall.Getrusage(syscall.RUSAGE_SELF, &self); err != nil {
		return diagRusage{}, errors.Wrap(err, "getrusage")
	}
	return diagRusage{
		UserNs: ns(0), SystemNs: ns(1), RunnableNs: ns(34), Pageins: word(4), Footprint: word(7),
		BytesRead: word(16), BytesWritten: word(17), LogicalWrites: word(27), Instructions: word(29), Cycles: word(30),
		MajorFaults: self.Majflt, MinorFaults: self.Minflt, Voluntary: self.Nvcsw, Involuntary: self.Nivcsw,
	}, nil
}

var diagMetricNames = []string{
	"/sync/mutex/wait/total:seconds",
	"/cpu/classes/gc/total:cpu-seconds",
	"/cpu/classes/gc/mark/assist:cpu-seconds",
	"/cpu/classes/idle:cpu-seconds",
	"/cpu/classes/user:cpu-seconds",
	"/cpu/classes/scavenge/total:cpu-seconds",
	"/cpu/classes/total:cpu-seconds",
	"/gc/cycles/total:gc-cycles",
	"/gc/heap/allocs:bytes",
	"/gc/heap/allocs:objects",
	"/sched/goroutines:goroutines",
	"/sched/latencies:seconds",
	"/sched/pauses/total/gc:seconds",
}

// readDiagMetrics reads the metrics of the runtime so far. Of a histogram it
// keeps how many events it has, their sum by the middle of every bucket, and
// how many took 100 µs, 1 ms and 10 ms or more.
func readDiagMetrics() map[string]float64 {
	samples := make([]metrics.Sample, len(diagMetricNames))
	for i, name := range diagMetricNames {
		samples[i].Name = name
	}
	metrics.Read(samples)
	out := map[string]float64{}
	for _, s := range samples {
		switch s.Value.Kind() {
		case metrics.KindUint64:
			out[s.Name] = float64(s.Value.Uint64())
		case metrics.KindFloat64:
			out[s.Name] = s.Value.Float64()
		case metrics.KindFloat64Histogram:
			h := s.Value.Float64Histogram()
			var count, sum, over100us, over1ms, over10ms float64
			for i, c := range h.Counts {
				low, high := h.Buckets[i], h.Buckets[i+1]
				mid := (low + high) / 2
				if math.IsInf(low, -1) {
					mid = high
				} else if math.IsInf(high, 1) {
					mid = low
				}
				count += float64(c)
				sum += float64(c) * mid
				if low >= 100e-6 {
					over100us += float64(c)
				}
				if low >= 1e-3 {
					over1ms += float64(c)
				}
				if low >= 10e-3 {
					over10ms += float64(c)
				}
			}
			out[s.Name+":count"], out[s.Name+":sum"] = count, sum
			out[s.Name+":over100us"], out[s.Name+":over1ms"], out[s.Name+":over10ms"] = over100us, over1ms, over10ms
		case metrics.KindBad:
			// This runtime does not have the metric.
		}
	}
	return out
}

// diagSegments counts the segments of every bucket of the store under dir.
func diagSegments(dir string) (map[string]int, error) {
	out := map[string]int{}
	root := filepath.Join(dir, "lsm")
	err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if !d.IsDir() && strings.HasSuffix(path, ".db") {
			rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, filepath.Dir(path))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			out[rel]++
		}
		return nil
	})
	return out, err
}

// byClass adds up by class of file what the files grew by so far.
func (w *dirWatch) byClass(gen int) map[string]int64 {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	out := map[string]int64{}
	for path, bytes := range w.grown {
		out[classOf(path, gen)] += bytes
	}
	return out
}

// openDiagStore is openNightStore with the cycles of a node, and without the
// compaction one where compaction is false: its callbacks are registered and
// nobody calls them, so the segments the flushes write stay as they are.
func openDiagStore(t *testing.T, dir string, logger logrus.FieldLogger, compaction bool) *nightStore {
	s := &nightStore{}
	routines := 2 * runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
	s.compaction = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/compaction", logger, routines)
	s.flush = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/flush", logger, routines)
	s.tombstones = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/tombstones", logger, routines)
	s.commitLogs = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/commitlogs", logger, routines)
	s.managers = []cyclemanager.CycleManager{
		cyclemanager.NewManager("night/flush", cyclemanager.MemtableFlushCycleTicker(true), s.flush.CycleCallback, logger),
		cyclemanager.NewManager("night/commitlogs", cyclemanager.HnswCommitLoggerCycleTicker(true), s.commitLogs.CycleCallback, logger),
		cyclemanager.NewManager("night/tombstones", cyclemanager.NewFixedTicker(300*time.Second), s.tombstones.CycleCallback, logger),
	}
	if compaction {
		s.managers = append(s.managers, cyclemanager.NewManager("night/compaction",
			cyclemanager.CompactionCycleTicker(true), s.compaction.CycleCallback, logger))
	}
	var err error
	s.store, err = lsmkv.New(filepath.Join(dir, "lsm"), dir, logger, nil, nil, s.compaction,
		cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroupNoop(), s.flush)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, m := range s.managers {
		m.Start()
	}
	return s
}

// diagVectors picks the vectors of a pass and their doc ids (PE_KIND), and
// reads them into memory. total is the rows of the dataset, and train.rows
// those the index was grown from. The caller holds nothing of the index.
func diagVectors(t *testing.T, p *Persistent, train *nightTrain, total int, datasetDir, kind string, n int,
	seed uint64,
) ([]uint64, [][]float32) {
	t.Helper()
	var rows []uint64
	// What is wrong is told once the index is let go: a failed require ends
	// the goroutine of the test, and the shutdown it defers takes the lock.
	problem := ""
	p.mu.RLock()
	g := p.g
	switch {
	case g == nil:
		problem = "the index has no base"
	case kind == "repeated" && g.meta.Live < 2*n:
		problem = "the index does not hold enough rows to pick from"
	case kind == "repeated":
		rng := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(seed, seed))
		seen := map[uint64]bool{}
		for len(rows) < n {
			row := uint64(rng.IntN(train.rows))
			if seen[row] || !g.holds(row) {
				continue
			}
			seen[row] = true
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
	case kind == "fresh" && train.rows+n > total:
		problem = "the dataset has no rows left after those the index was grown from"
	case kind == "fresh":
		for i := range n {
			rows = append(rows, uint64(train.rows+i))
		}
	case kind == "queries":
	default:
		problem = "PE_KIND is repeated, fresh or queries, not " + kind
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	require.Empty(t, problem)

	var ids []uint64
	var vectors [][]float32
	if kind == "queries" {
		queries, _, _ := readNightQueries(t, datasetDir, 10)
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(queries), n, "the dataset has that many queries")
		vectors = queries[:n]
	} else {
		var err error
		vectors, _, err = train.read(rows, nil)
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}
	if kind == "fresh" {
		ids = rows
	} else {
		ids = make([]uint64, n)
		for i := range ids {
			ids[i] = uint64(train.rows) + uint64(i)
		}
	}
	held := -1
	p.mu.RLock()
	for i, id := range ids {
		if p.g.holds(id) {
			held = i
			break
		}
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	require.Negative(t, held, "one of the doc ids of the pass is in the index already")
	return ids, vectors
}

// diagStretch is everything that has added up when a stretch ends: all of it
// since the process or the index started, so that a stretch is the
// difference between two.
type diagStretch struct {
	At       string  `json:"at"`
	Inserted int     `json:"inserted"`
	Seconds  float64 `json:"seconds"`
	// AddSeconds is the time of the rounds of AddBatch by the clock, and
	// FlushSeconds that of the Flush after each.
	AddSeconds   float64            `json:"addSeconds"`
	FlushSeconds float64            `json:"flushSeconds"`
	Clocks       map[string]int64   `json:"clocks,omitempty"`
	Stats        growStats          `json:"stats"`
	Rusage       diagRusage         `json:"rusage"`
	Runtime      map[string]float64 `json:"runtime"`
	Store        map[string]int64   `json:"store"`
	Segments     map[string]int     `json:"segments"`
	FilesGrown   map[string]int64   `json:"filesGrownByClass"`
	Journal      growIO             `json:"journal"`
	Live         int                `json:"live"`
	Postings     int                `json:"postings"`
	HeapInuse    uint64             `json:"heapInuse"`
	HeapAlloc    uint64             `json:"heapAlloc"`
	NumGC        uint32             `json:"numGC"`
}

type diagResult struct {
	Dir         string        `json:"dir"`
	Dataset     string        `json:"dataset"`
	Kind        string        `json:"kind"`
	Rows        int           `json:"rows"`
	Seed        uint64        `json:"seed"`
	N           int           `json:"n"`
	Callers     int           `json:"callers"`
	Every       int           `json:"every"`
	Branch      bool          `json:"diagnosticBranch"`
	Clocks      bool          `json:"clocksOn"`
	Work        bool          `json:"planWork"`
	Compaction  bool          `json:"compaction"`
	CacheMode   string        `json:"cacheMode"`
	Procs       int           `json:"gomaxprocs"`
	Pid         int           `json:"pid"`
	OpenSeconds float64       `json:"openSeconds"`
	Meta        growMeta      `json:"metaAtStart"`
	Generation  int           `json:"generation"`
	Traced      string        `json:"tracedFrom,omitempty"`
	Stretches   []diagStretch `json:"stretches"`
	Done        bool          `json:"done"`
}

func TestDiagInserts(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" || os.Getenv("PE_THREADS") != "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR and PE_OUT given, or PE_THREADS given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	datasetRows := nightRows(t, train)
	n := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_N", 20000))
	callers := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_CALLERS", 8))
	every := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_EVERY", 2000))
	seed := uint64(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SEED", 7))
	kind := nightEnv("PE_KIND", "repeated")
	clocksOn := nightEnv("PE_CLOCKS", "1") != "0"
	work := nightEnv("PE_WORK", "0") == "1"
	compaction := nightEnv("PE_COMPACTION", "1") != "0"
	profilePath, tracePath := os.Getenv("PE_CPUPROFILE"), os.Getenv("PE_TRACE")
	traceFor := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_TRACE_SECONDS", 8)) * time.Second

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	openedAt := time.Now()
	st := openDiagStore(t, dir, logger, compaction)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	clocks, hooksOff := diagHooks(&cfg, clocksOn, work)
	defer hooksOff()
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	opened := time.Since(openedAt)
	shut := func() {
		if p == nil {
			return
		}
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		st.stopCycles(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
		p = nil
	}
	defer shut()

	ids, vectors := diagVectors(t, p, train, datasetRows, datasetDir, kind, n, seed)
	p.mu.RLock()
	result := &diagResult{
		Dir: dir, Dataset: datasetDir, Kind: kind, Rows: train.rows, Seed: seed, N: n, Callers: callers, Every: every,
		Branch: diagBranch, Clocks: clocksOn && diagBranch, Work: work && diagBranch, Compaction: compaction, CacheMode: uc.RQ.CacheMode, Procs: runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), Pid: os.Getpid(),
		OpenSeconds: opened.Seconds(), Meta: p.g.meta, Generation: int(p.g.meta.VectorGen),
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	t.Logf("opened in %s: %d vectors, %d postings given out; %d %s vectors with %d callers",
		opened.Round(time.Millisecond), result.Meta.Live, result.Meta.Postings, n, kind, callers)

	watch := newDirWatch(t, dir, logger)
	var addTime, flushTime time.Duration
	var begin time.Time
	stretch := func(inserted int) {
		t.Helper()
		usage, err := readDiagRusage()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		segments, err := diagSegments(dir)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var mem runtime.MemStats
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem)
		s := diagStretch{
			At: time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), Inserted: inserted, Seconds: time.Since(begin).Seconds(),
			AddSeconds: addTime.Seconds(), FlushSeconds: flushTime.Seconds(), Rusage: usage,
			Runtime: readDiagMetrics(), Store: diagStore(), Segments: segments,
			FilesGrown: watch.byClass(result.Generation), HeapInuse: mem.HeapInuse, HeapAlloc: mem.HeapAlloc,
			NumGC: mem.NumGC,
		}
		if clocks != nil {
			s.Clocks = clocks()
		}
		p.mu.RLock()
		g := p.g
		s.Stats, s.Live, s.Postings = g.stats, g.meta.Live, g.meta.Postings
		s.Journal = growIO{N: int64(g.journal.records), Bytes: int64(g.journal.bytes)}
		p.mu.RUnlock()
		result.Stretches = append(result.Stretches, s)
		writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	}

	var stopTrace sync.Once
	var traceFile *os.File
	endTrace := func() {
		stopTrace.Do(func() {
			if traceFile != nil {
				trace.Stop()
				_ = traceFile.Close()
			}
		})
	}
	defer endTrace()
	if profilePath != "" {
		file, err := os.Create(profilePath)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer file.Close()
		require.NoError(t, pprof.StartCPUProfile(file))
		defer pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	}

	// Whoever samples the process from outside waits for this file.
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(out+".started", []byte(time.Now().Format("15:04:05")+"\n"), 0o644))
	const batch = 100
	begin = time.Now()
	stretch(0)
	next := every
	for at := 0; at < n; {
		to := min(at+batch*callers, n)
		if tracePath != "" && traceFile == nil && at >= n/2 {
			traceFile, err = os.Create(tracePath)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, trace.Start(traceFile))
			result.Traced = time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
			time.AfterFunc(traceFor, endTrace)
		}
		clock := time.Now()
		adding := enterrors.NewErrorGroupWrapper(logger)
		for start := at; start < to; start += batch {
			end := min(start+batch, to)
			adding.Go(func() error { return p.AddBatch(ctx, ids[start:end], vectors[start:end]) })
		}
		require.NoError(t, adding.Wait())
		addTime += time.Since(clock)
		clock = time.Now()
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		flushTime += time.Since(clock)
		at = to
		if at >= next || at == n {
			stretch(at)
			for next <= at {
				next += every
			}
		}
	}
	took := time.Since(begin)
	endTrace()
	watch.stop()
	result.Done = true
	writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	t.Logf("%d inserts in %s, %.1f a second: %s adding and %s in the flush of every round", n,
		took.Round(time.Millisecond), float64(n)/took.Seconds(), addTime.Round(time.Millisecond),
		flushTime.Round(time.Millisecond))
}

// diagPlans is what the plans of a pass of TestDiagSearch added up to.
type diagPlans struct {
	Plans        int   `json:"plans"`
	AssignNs     int64 `json:"assignNs"`
	SearchNs     int64 `json:"searchNs"`
	FetchNs      int64 `json:"searchFetchNs"`
	VisitNs      int64 `json:"searchVisitNs"`
	RescoreNs    int64 `json:"searchRescoreNs"`
	MemberReadNs int64 `json:"searchMemberReadNs"`
	EdgeReadNs   int64 `json:"searchEdgeReadNs"`
	Loads        int   `json:"searchLoads"`
	Rounds       int   `json:"searchRounds"`
	Rows         int   `json:"searchRows"`
	RowBytes     int   `json:"searchRowBytes"`
	Members      int   `json:"searchMembers"`
	Rescored     int   `json:"searchRescored"`
	VectorReads  int   `json:"searchVectorReads"`
}

func (d *diagPlans) add(plan *growPlan) {
	searched := &plan.searched
	d.Plans++
	d.AssignNs += int64(plan.assignTime)
	d.SearchNs += int64(plan.searchTime)
	d.FetchNs += int64(searched.FetchTime)
	d.VisitNs += int64(searched.VisitTime)
	d.RescoreNs += int64(searched.RescoreTime)
	d.MemberReadNs += int64(searched.MemberTime)
	d.EdgeReadNs += int64(searched.EdgeTime)
	d.Loads += searched.Postings
	d.Rounds += searched.Rounds
	d.Rows += searched.Blocks
	d.RowBytes += searched.BlockBytes
	d.Members += searched.Members
	d.Rescored += searched.Rescored
	d.VectorReads += plan.vectorReads
}

func (d *diagPlans) merge(o *diagPlans) {
	d.Plans += o.Plans
	d.AssignNs += o.AssignNs
	d.SearchNs += o.SearchNs
	d.FetchNs += o.FetchNs
	d.VisitNs += o.VisitNs
	d.RescoreNs += o.RescoreNs
	d.MemberReadNs += o.MemberReadNs
	d.EdgeReadNs += o.EdgeReadNs
	d.Loads += o.Loads
	d.Rounds += o.Rounds
	d.Rows += o.Rows
	d.RowBytes += o.RowBytes
	d.Members += o.Members
	d.Rescored += o.Rescored
	d.VectorReads += o.VectorReads
}

// TestDiagSearch runs the plans of the vectors of a pass and applies none of
// them: the search of an insert as a query, with the ef and the neighbors of
// an insert, over the index as it is. PE_THREADS goroutines take the vectors
// a window at a time and hold the index for reading over each window, as the
// callers of AddBatch do. It opens the index with no cycle and no
// maintenance: nothing is written.
func TestDiagSearch(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" || os.Getenv("PE_THREADS") == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR, PE_OUT and PE_THREADS given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	datasetRows := nightRows(t, train)
	n := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_N", 20000))
	threads := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_THREADS", 1))
	seed := uint64(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SEED", 7))
	kind := nightEnv("PE_KIND", "repeated")
	profilePath := os.Getenv("PE_CPUPROFILE")

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	_, hooksOff := diagHooks(&cfg, true, false)
	defer hooksOff()
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}()
	ids, vectors := diagVectors(t, p, train, datasetRows, datasetDir, kind, n, seed)
	p.mu.RLock()
	meta := p.g.meta
	p.mu.RUnlock()

	if profilePath != "" {
		file, err := os.Create(profilePath)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer file.Close()
		require.NoError(t, pprof.StartCPUProfile(file))
		defer pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	}
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(out+".started", []byte(time.Now().Format("15:04:05")+"\n"), 0o644))
	usageBefore, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	runtimeBefore, storeBefore := readDiagMetrics(), diagStore()
	var next atomic.Int64
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var total diagPlans
	begin := time.Now()
	searching := enterrors.NewErrorGroupWrapper(logger)
	for range threads {
		searching.Go(func() error {
			var own diagPlans
			defer func() {
				mu.Lock()
				total.merge(&own)
				mu.Unlock()
			}()
			for {
				from := int(next.Add(insertWindow)) - insertWindow
				if from >= n {
					return nil
				}
				to := min(from+insertWindow, n)
				p.mu.RLock()
				for i := from; i < to; i++ {
					plan := p.plans.Get().(*growPlan)
					plan.work = nil
					err := p.g.plan(ctx, plan, ids[i], distancer.Normalize(vectors[i]))
					if err == nil {
						own.add(plan)
					}
					p.plans.Put(plan)
					if err != nil {
						p.mu.RUnlock()
						return err
					}
				}
				p.mu.RUnlock()
			}
		})
	}
	require.NoError(t, searching.Wait())
	took := time.Since(begin)
	usage, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	writeNightJSON(t, out, map[string]any{
		"dir": dir, "dataset": datasetDir, "kind": kind, "rows": train.rows, "seed": seed, "n": n, "threads": threads,
		"cacheMode": uc.RQ.CacheMode, "gomaxprocs": runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), "pid": os.Getpid(), "meta": meta,
		"diagnosticBranch": diagBranch,
		"seconds":          took.Seconds(), "plans": total,
		"rusageBefore": usageBefore, "rusageAfter": usage,
		"runtimeBefore": runtimeBefore, "runtimeAfter": readDiagMetrics(),
		"storeBefore": storeBefore, "storeAfter": diagStore(),
	})
	t.Logf("%d plans with %d threads in %s: %.3f ms a plan by its clock, %.1f loads", total.Plans, threads,
		took.Round(time.Millisecond), float64(total.AssignNs+total.SearchNs)/1e6/float64(max(total.Plans, 1)),
		float64(total.Loads)/float64(max(total.Plans, 1)))
}
